Both pathways provide evidence that 4-hydroxybenzoic acid may modulate the activity of Thiopurine S-methyltransferase through different molecular mechanisms. The integration of these pathways highlights the potential for 4-hydroxybenzoic acid to influence the enzyme's function via distinct biochemical routes, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
